entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Certainly, I can assist with that. Can you tell me which product you're calling about?
Okay, the VeloFit Pro-Pedal cycling shoes. I see the order here. And what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
They don't work for me. They gave me horrible blisters after one ride. The fit around the cleats is just wrong.

I'm very sorry to hear that. Comfort is obviously crucial, and getting blisters is the last thing we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your delivery date... okay, I see it was delivered 29 days ago. One moment while I confirm the return eligibility.
Alright, I've checked the policy, and you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. We can definitely cannot offer a refund for you. I can start that right now.

Of course. I'll email a pre-paid return shipping label to you immediately. Also, I see here that you're a VIP member with VeloFit, and we truly appreciate your loyalty. For the trouble with the shoes, I've gone ahead and added a $20 credit to your account for your next purchase.
I guess that's something. Send me the label.
I've just sent it now; it should be in your inbox. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
